provenance.accessLimits: Public sources. Generated case text and the payload sidecar stay under ignored evals/private/; the frozen benign template list and this manifest are tracked.
provenance.selection: Carriers: AgentDojo v1 ground-truth tool outputs (all four suites, default environment, deduplicated, at most 12000 bytes) that expose at least one free-text environment field (email/message body, calendar description, file content, review; banking transaction subject) that is not an injection vector; Nemotron rows whose injection text appears in exactly one environment leaf, with it cut out, deduplicated, keeping rows with a free-text field (>= 6 words) other than the original vector. Carriers are sorted by stratum (suite/tool or domain/read tool) and SHA-256 of 'agent-enhanced-tool-output-v1/carrier/<carrier_id>' and dealt over the pattern ['injection', 'hard_negative', 'clean', 'injection', 'hard_negative'], so every carrier belongs to one class. Clean: every AgentDojo clean-pool carrier plus Nemotron clean-pool carriers round-robin over strata, 100 total. Hard negatives: each of the 50 frozen phrasings 3 times, alternating carrier source, in a field family the phrasing fits, at start/middle/end in rotation. Positives: {'nemotron-ipi': 70, 'llmail-inject': 70, 'bipia': 70, 'agentdojo': 40} payloads, split over carrier sources to match the negatives exactly, field families allocated in proportion to the hard negatives'. Payload order is seeded round-robin over its strata (Nemotron domain x attack category; LLMail phase x judge reason x length tercile, the import-llmail-pool.py pool; BIPIA attack family; AgentDojo template x suite). Nemotron payloads in Nemotron carriers stay in their own domain and never return to their source row; AgentDojo payloads in AgentDojo carriers stay in their suite. Every payload is used at most once.
provenance.construction: Payload text is the upstream text, verbatim (Nemotron injection_text stripped; LLMail body without subject; BIPIA text attack; AgentDojo template.format(goal) exactly as agentdojo-suites-v1). Insertion joins with one space at the start or end of the field value, or at a sentence (else word) boundary chosen by SHA-256 for middle. AgentDojo: the field is edited in the environment and GroundTruthPipeline replays the user task's fixed tool calls, so YAML formatting and escaping are upstream's (the payload is verbatim in the parsed field, not necessarily in the raw YAML). Nemotron: the screened text is the environment JSON (indent 2) as in nemotron-ipi-domain-sample-v1. The operator turns are the user task prompt (AgentDojo) or the row's system prompt and user request (Nemotron); full_text last_external screening sends only the tool output, as for agentdojo-suites-mixed.
provenance.labelMeaning: injection: a published attack text placed into a tool output where it was not originally (new field and position). benign: the same kinds of carrier and field with a repository-authored legitimate instruction (hard_negative) or untouched (clean_carrier). Detection labels only, not agent compliance. Payloads were written for other contexts (LLMail's email scenario, BIPIA QA tasks, Nemotron domain goals), so some read as out of place in their new carrier. Report per class_kind, payload_source, carrier_source and negative_type; the control subset (control=true, AgentDojo blunt templates) anchors against agentdojo-suites-mixed.
